ttab.everysport.ApplyDefaultsRequest.description: ApplyDefaultsRequest writes the defaults of a sport or a category to the rows below it. At least one field must be picked, or there is nothing to apply. Applying from a sport always writes its categories as well as its competitions: the choice on offer is which fields, not which tier.

apply_merge_setting.description: ApplyMergeSetting includes the merge strategy in what is written. The merge strategy is part of the identity of the documents a competition publishes, so changing it on an enabled competition leaves the events it has already published behind under their old identifiers.

apply_newsvalue.description: ApplyNewsvalue includes the newsvalue in what is written.

apply_sport.description: ApplySport includes the topic names in what is written.

category_id.description: CategoryID applies the defaults of a category.

competition_states.description: CompetitionStates selects the competitions to write, by review state. Required, at least one, and STATE_UNSPECIFIED is rejected. Categories are not selected by it: they have no state, and applying from a sport always writes them.

dry_run.description: DryRun reports what would change and writes nothing. The rows it lists are the rows a call without it writes, as of when it ran: a discovery sweep or a review decision landing in between can change them.

sport_id.description: SportID applies the defaults of a sport. Exactly one of sport_id and category_id is required.

categories.description: Categories is the number of category rows that change.

changes.description: Changes are the rows that change, ordered by category and name.

competitions.description: Competitions is the number of competition rows that change.

dry_run.description: DryRun repeats the flag from the request: false means the changes listed were written.

enabled_competitions.description: EnabledCompetitions is how many of those competitions are enabled, which are the rows where an apply changes something that is already published.

ttab.everysport.CategoryConfig.description: CategoryConfig is an Everysport competition category. The category tier carries no import settings of its own: it groups competitions under a sport, and holds the defaults new competitions in it are created with.

comment.description: Comment is a free text note for whoever configures the import.

gender.description: Gender is the gender category slug, if any.

id.description: ID is the Everysport competition category ID.

name.description: Name is the Everysport category name.

seen.description: Seen is when the category was last listed by Everysport, as RFC3339.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport ID of the sport the category belongs to.

updated.description: Updated is when the comment or the defaults last changed, as RFC3339.

updated_by.description: UpdatedBy is the subject that last changed them.

ttab.everysport.CompetitionConfig.description: CompetitionConfig is the import configuration for an Everysport competition. Competitions are identified by their static ID, the competition ID changes between seasons.

category_id.description: CategoryID is the Everysport ID of the competition category.

competition_id.description: CompetitionID is the Everysport competition ID we saw last.

full_name.description: FullName is the full Everysport competition name.

gender.description: Gender is the gender category slug, if any.

name.description: Name is the Everysport competition name.

seen.description: Seen is when the competition was last listed by Everysport, as RFC3339.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport ID of the sport the competition belongs to.

static_id.description: StaticID is the Everysport static ID of the competition.

updated.description: Updated is when the settings last changed, as RFC3339.

updated_by.description: UpdatedBy is the subject that last changed the settings.

ttab.everysport.CompetitionRef.description: CompetitionRef identifies one competition. The static ID is unique on its own in practice, but the sport is what the configuration is keyed on.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport sport ID. Required.

static_id.description: StaticID is the Everysport competition static ID. Required.

ttab.everysport.ConfigState.description: ConfigState is the review state of a configuration entry. Entries that the service discovers on its own start out as pending.

ttab.everysport.ConfigWarning.description: ConfigWarning is a problem with a configuration entry that doesn't stop it from being saved.

code.description: Code identifies the kind of problem, f.ex. "unresolved_sport_name".

field.description: Field is the name of the offending settings field.

message.description: Message is a human readable description of the problem.

ttab.everysport.DefaultsChange.description: DefaultsChange is one row that an apply changes, with the old and the new value of every field that changes on it. A field that isn't being applied, or that already holds the value being applied, is left out, and a row where nothing would change is not reported at all.

category_id.description: CategoryID is the category itself for a category row, and the category the competition belongs to for a competition row. Zero when a competition has no known category.

category_name.description: CategoryName is the name of that category, empty when there is none.

name.description: Name is the name of the row itself.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport ID of the sport the row belongs to.

static_id.description: StaticID is the Everysport competition static ID, zero for a category.

ttab.everysport.DefaultsTier.description: DefaultsTier is the configuration tier a changed row sits in.

csv.description: CSV is the full configuration as a CSV file.

id.description: ID is the Everysport competition category ID. Required.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport sport ID. Required.

static_id.description: StaticID is the Everysport competition static ID. Required.

id.description: ID is the Everysport sport ID. Required.

ttab.everysport.ImportDefaults.description:
ImportDefaults is the editable part of a competition category. A category imports nothing itself, so it has no state: its values are what a competition discovered under it is created with, and what ApplyDefaults writes downward.
 This is deliberately not an ImportSettings. A category with a state field would be a field that has to be ignored, and "unset" is a real value here where it is not one on a competition: a template can be unset, a field that decides what a document says cannot.

merge_setting.description: MergeSetting is the merge strategy new competitions are created with, one of "NoMerge", "CategoryMerge" and "CompetitionMerge". Empty means that no default is set and the sport's is used instead.

newsvalue.description: Newsvalue is the newsvalue new competitions are created with, 1 to 5. Zero means that no default is set and the sport's is used instead.

sport.description: Sport is the list of TT media topic names new competitions are created with. Empty means that no default is set and the sport's are used instead.

ttab.everysport.ImportSettings.description:
ImportSettings is the editable part of a sport or competition configuration. All other fields identify the entry and are read only.
 Nothing here is inherited: a competition is imported with the settings on its own row. The settings of a sport are the defaults its new competitions are created with, plus its own review state.

comment.description: Comment is a free text note for whoever configures the import.

merge_setting.description: MergeSetting is the strategy used to group entries into events, and it names the shape of the documents that come out: "NoMerge" gives one event per calendar entry, "CategoryMerge" one event per category and day, and "CompetitionMerge" one event per competition and day. Required when enabling an entry.

newsvalue.description: Newsvalue is the value of the core/newsvalue block of created events, 1 to 5. Required when enabling an entry.

sport.description: Sport is the list of TT media topic names that events are linked to through core/category links, in addition to the generic "Sport" topic. Required when enabling an entry: an entry with no names of its own publishes events linked to the generic topic and nothing else.

sport_id.description: SportID is the sport to list categories for. Optional, all sports when left out.

categories.description: Categories are the matching categories, ordered by sport and name.

category_id.description: CategoryID only returns competitions in the given category. Optional.

limit.description: Limit is the maximum number of competitions to return. Optional.

offset.description: Offset is the number of competitions to skip. Optional.

query.description: Query only returns competitions whose name matches. Optional.

sport_id.description: SportID only returns competitions for the given sport. Optional.

stale.description: Stale only returns competitions that Everysport no longer lists.

competitions.description: Competitions are the matching competitions, ordered by name.

total.description: Total is the number of competitions that match, ignoring offset and limit.

only_enabled.description: OnlyEnabled excludes the competitions that wouldn't import anyway, which is every entry that isn't enabled. Optional.

imports.description: Imports are the competitions with skipped entries, ordered by sport and competition name.

query.description: Query only returns sports whose name matches. Optional.

sports.description: Sports are the matching sports, ordered by name.

category.description: Category only re-imports the events with the specific category.

competition.description: Category only re-imports the events for the specific competition static ID.

competitions.description: Competitions only re-imports the events for the given competition static IDs. Combines with competition: an event matches if its static ID is in either. Optional.

from_date.description: FromDate is the date from which to fetch events for import. Optional, defaults to today.

to_date.description: FromDate is the last date we should get events for. Optional.

queued_imports.description: QueuedImports is the total numer of events that were queued for import.

ttab.everysport.MergeSettingChange.description: MergeSettingChange is what an apply does to a merge strategy.

from.description: From is the value the row has now.

to.description: To is the value the apply writes.

ttab.everysport.NewsvalueChange.description: NewsvalueChange is what an apply does to a newsvalue.

from.description: From is the value the row has now.

to.description: To is the value the apply writes.

ttab.everysport.PendingImport.description: PendingImport is a competition with calendar entries that the service saw and skipped, because the competition or its sport was not enabled at the time. Enabling the competition does not import them: the entries have gone past in the update feed, and only a manual import brings them back. An entry stops being counted as soon as it is imported, so the list empties itself as the re-imports land.

entries.description: Entries is the number of calendar entries that are still missing.

from_date.description: FromDate is the date of the earliest skipped entry, as YYYY-MM-DD.

last_seen.description: LastSeen is when an entry was last skipped, as RFC3339.

name.description: Name is the Everysport competition name.

queued.description: Queued is how many of the missing entries are on the re-import queue already, waiting for the syncer to reach them. Counted from the queue itself, so it is what is actually pending rather than what was asked for.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport ID of the sport the competition belongs to.

sport_name.description: SportName is the Everysport sport name.

static_id.description: StaticID is the Everysport static ID of the competition.

to_date.description: ToDate is the date of the latest skipped entry, as YYYY-MM-DD.

competitions.description: Competitions to decide. Required, and every one of them must exist.

newsvalue.description: Newsvalue to give them. Required when the state is STATE_ENABLED, ignored otherwise.

updated.description: Updated is the number of competitions that were changed.

warnings.description: Warnings are problems with the settings that were saved.

ttab.everysport.SportChange.description: SportChange is what an apply does to a list of topic names.

from.description: From are the names the row has now.

to.description: To are the names the apply writes.

ttab.everysport.SportConfig.description: SportConfig is the import configuration for an Everysport sport.

id.description: ID is the Everysport sport ID.

name.description: Name is the Everysport sport name.

pending_competitions.description: PendingCompetitions is the number of competitions of the sport that are awaiting review.

seen.description: Seen is when the sport was last listed by Everysport, as RFC3339.

slug.description: Slug is the Everysport sport slug.

updated.description: Updated is when the settings last changed, as RFC3339.

updated_by.description: UpdatedBy is the subject that last changed the settings.

comment.description: Comment replaces the current comment of the category.

id.description: ID is the Everysport competition category ID. Required.

warnings.description: Warnings are problems with the saved defaults.

sport_id.description: SportID is the Everysport sport ID. Required.

static_id.description: StaticID is the Everysport competition static ID. Required.

warnings.description: Warnings are problems with the saved settings.

id.description: ID is the Everysport sport ID. Required.

warnings.description: Warnings are problems with the saved settings.

post.description: ApplyDefaults writes the defaults of a sport or a category to the rows below it. With dry_run set it reports what would change and writes nothing, which is what the preview shown before an apply is built from.
ExportConfig returns the full import configuration as CSV.
GetCategory returns a single competition category.
GetCompetition returns a single competition configuration.
GetSport returns a single sport configuration.
ListCategories lists competition categories, for one sport or for all of them. A category imports nothing of its own, it carries the defaults that new competitions under it are created with.
ListCompetitions lists competitions in the import configuration.
ListPendingImports lists the competitions that have calendar entries the service skipped, with the date range those entries fall in.
ListSports lists the sports in the import configuration.
ManualImport re-imports calendar events based on a search query.
ReviewCompetitions decides a batch of competitions at once, which is what working through the review queue is.
UpdateCategory replaces the comment and the import defaults of a competition category.
UpdateCompetition replaces the editable settings of a competition.
UpdateSport replaces the editable settings of a sport.
